item.title: Ballard Creek Fire burns over 400 acres near Matador
item.description: MOTLEY COUNTY, Texas -- According to the Texas A&M Forest Service, a wildfire near Matador burned over 400 acres Friday. The fire, dubbed the Ballard Creek Fire, was 85 percent contained, as of 7:40 p.m. Friday after burning 406 acres north of Matador. This is an ongoing situation. EverythingLubbock.com will provide updates when available.
